apps.localizedDescription:
ForKey is a high-precision acoustic piano tuning application for iOS.

Key Features:
• 4-partial real-time stroboscopic phase visualizer
• Inharmonicity B parameter calibration and global curve fitting
• Railsback stretch curve computation
• Automatic note detection with rock-solid hysteresis locking
• Inharmonicity Calibration Wizard across 88 keys
• Floating Swifty Debugger HUD & Calculations Inspector
• Screen sleep prevention while tuning
• Configurable acoustic sensitivity and noise gate thresholds with live dBFS meter
